name: Akbar Sha
title: Software Developer
intro: I like turning ideas into things that actually work. I build software, solve tricky problems, connect systems, and occasionally wonder why the code worked five minutes ago. Most importantly, I enjoy what I do.
about: Hi, I’m Akbar Sha. I’m a software developer with 3+ years of experience developing, designing, and implementing solutions across different platforms and technologies. At Tryzens Global, I have worked on storefront features, third-party integrations, design implementations, API development, and integrations for various enterprise clients across Salesforce B2C Commerce and MuleSoft platforms. I have earned certifications in Salesforce B2C Commerce, MuleSoft, and Agentforce. I love to code, research, and learn.
Outside of work, I enjoy watching movies, TV shows, and anime, following football, and spending time with friends and family.

contributions: Delivered SFCC storefront features across multiple enterprise clients — product pages, promotions, checkout flows, and payment integrations.
Integrated loyalty and marketing platforms, and configured SFCC jobs, services, and API endpoints to automate business processes.
Architected MuleSoft integrations connecting Adobe Commerce, OMS, and third-party systems for inventory, catalog, tax, and shipping workflows.
Built React components for headless commerce projects, turning client designs into responsive, reusable storefronts.
Focused on stable, defect-free delivery, maintaining a sub-5% post-release defect rate across client engagements.
Full-stack internship in Python and Django, building an e-commerce application and several CRUD web apps.
Earned the Python Web Development Expert certification through project-based learning.
